title: Product of Array Except Self
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n, the number of elements.
Line 2: n space-separated integers, the array nums.
outputFormat: n space-separated integers, where the i-th value is the product of every element of nums except nums[i].
constraints:
2 <= n <= 10^5
-30 <= nums[i] <= 30
The product of any prefix or suffix fits in a 32-bit signed integer.

examples.explanation: Only index 2 avoids the zero, giving -1*1*-3*3 = 9.
